difficulty_reason: H2: Under exactly the original locally finite-irreducible-component conditions, construct the normalization of an algebraic space. Given scheme normalization and its smooth/etale base-change properties, the author normalizes U and R=U×_XU, constructs the source/target/composition/inverse/unit on R^nu, proves the relation map is a monomorphism, forms U^nu/R^nu, and proves descent of generic-point-compatible morphisms and independence of the chosen cover. This is the actual quotient/groupoid construction of the global normalization, not merely the finiteness criterion under Nagata assumptions. The author omissions at the end, including the hinted proof of smooth compatibility, are retained without supplementation.
